top_signals.title: Reese Witherspoon Buys Back Production Firm With Mediawan
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Chris Palmeri joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Actress Reese Witherspoon is repurchasing her film and TV production company Hello Sunshine from Candle Media in partnership with Mediawan, according to a statement from the French entertainment firm. (Source: Bloomberg)
